title: PackManagerEvidenceRecord
description: Standard evidence record produced by Step 03 (Pack Manager) at box seal. Consumed downstream by Step 04 (Returns Manager) and Step 05 (Recovery Manager) via unit_id.

record_id.description: Unique identifier for this pack event, prefixed with PCK-.

unit_id.description: Cross-stage join key (UNIT-0001 to UNIT-0100) tracking the physical unit across Receiving, Prep, Pack, Returns, and Recovery.

station_id.description: Identifier of the packing station or terminal where the box was packed.

status.description: Execution status of the verification. 'failed_open' indicates model timeout or outage where capture is preserved and operator is not blocked.

order_lines.description: Expected SKUs and quantities ordered by the buyer.

observed_in_box.description: SKUs and quantities physically extracted by the vision agent from the open box photograph.

images.description: Array of URIs or presigned storage paths representing the open-box visual evidence before seal.

checks.description: Line-by-line verification checks comparing expected order lines to visual evidence.

decision.description: Final operational judgment. SEAL authorizes closing the box; STOP_AND_FIX halts packing; UNCERTAIN flags for human review.

decided_by.description: Agent or operator identifier who produced the decision.

overrides.description: Audit log of any human operator manual overrides applied to the decision.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 cryptographic digest of the record content for tamper evidence across the chain.
